ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions on distal portions of both lobes; central low-intensity (black) region forming a wedge shape from peduncle to notch; dark pixel mottling concentrated along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle calculated at approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/6th of total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregularity with varied pixel-amplitude; notable deep indentation on the left lobe inner trailing edge; multiple small peaks (10-20 pixels in height) distributed along both lobes distal to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the central axis to the distal tips, terminating in slightly recurved, pointed lobe ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity (white) circular clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes and sporadically along the superior edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel horizontal low-intensity (dark) rake marks visible on the white field of the right lobe; several vertical high-contrast linear streaks visible within the central dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-linear excision/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple irregular serrations and missing tissue segments along the entirety of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast dark intersecting linear marks (resembling an 'X') located on the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe's white field.
